source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946, p. 5 ("Municipal elections: complete list of nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: the only councillor nominees in the ward in the News-Letter's nomination list (no councillors' poll in the results)

note: Election of the whole of Belfast Corporation (an alderman and three councillors in each of the 15 wards) under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946, polled Wednesday 18 September 1946; the first since the war. Seven wards were counted on the morning of 19 September and the rest that afternoon; the Unionists kept an overall majority of 26 (Belfast Telegraph, 19 and 20 September 1946). Falls, Smithfield and Windsor had no councillors' poll and Court, Smithfield and Windsor no aldermanic poll (Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946). Citation unconfirmed: the names were not all found on the cited page (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
